content:
I’ve been writing software since 2021, starting as an intern at TopOnTech, where I picked up the habit that still shapes how I work: break the problem down, picture every step, then write the code.

Since then I’ve built backend systems across telecom, finance, and agriculture. At FPT Telecom, I built internal tools used by branches nationwide. At VietCredit, I worked on loan approval, contract management, and partner APIs, including the integration behind loan disbursement. At GreenFeed, I started building the systems that run daily operations at 32+ farms across Vietnam, and kept owning them after moving to Excel Technologies, the group’s dedicated tech unit: warehouse, sales & delivery, order creation, planning, e-invoicing, and SAP integration. Along the way I’ve also taken on freelance work, from e-commerce sites to Telegram bots that crunch data and run custom commands.

My sweet spot is the unglamorous stuff that makes everything else work: SQL performance, clean APIs, security, system integration, and turning messy requests into something that actually runs. One of my favorite wins was handling bulk inserts hundreds of times larger than before by passing XML parameter lists straight into SQL Server stored procedures. For slow queries my rule is simple: narrow the data first, join second, and never make the database run a function on every row, even if that means adding dedicated day, month, and year columns just to keep queries fast.

I mostly live in .NET with SQL Server and Postgres, plus Node, Docker, and message queues, and I’ll pick up React or jQuery when a feature needs to ship end to end. Lately I’ve been deep into AI-assisted development with Claude Code.

Teammates usually come to me asking “how does this thing actually work?”, and I love that question. I also mentor interns now and then, less about syntax and more about how to think through a problem.

Off the keyboard you’ll find me doing pull-ups, playing badminton, swimming, or sipping black coffee somewhere shady with plants around. Cats and rabbits are a bonus.

Open to freelance projects and backend roles. Got a messy problem? Let’s talk.
